## Executive Summary

Dileepa Prabhath is a high-achieving Information Technology undergraduate at the University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka's top-ranked technological university. Maintaining an exceptional cumulative GPA of 3.96/4.00, he has repeatedly earned Dean's List honors (L1S1, L1S2, L2S1).

His core engineering focus spans full-stack web application architecture, robust backend development with Java Spring Boot and Node.js/Express, modern frontend engineering with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, secure distributed system design, and the applied integration of Machine Learning and Computer Vision models into real-world software.

## In-Depth Project Catalog

### 1. ServeSync (CraveHouse)
- **Problem & Solution**: Addresses inefficient coordination and bottlenecked order delivery in busy multi-branch dining establishments. Enables customers to scan table QR codes or place online orders, instantly updating kitchen displays and dining floor inventory.
- **Tech Stack**: Spring Boot (Java), React (JavaScript), MySQL, Redis caching
- **Key Capabilities**: Real-time table status tracking, automated reservation workflows, synchronized kitchen ticket dispatching.
- **Live Demo**: https://cravehouse.netlify.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Byte-knight-team/BK_SP_Backend

### 2. SplitRx
- **Problem & Solution**: Medical prescription fraud and sensitive patient data leakage pose serious threats to healthcare security. SplitRx is engineered with cryptographic integrity verification, multi-factor authorization, and secure state handling to eliminate forgery.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Express.js, PostgreSQL
- **Key Capabilities**: Tamper-proof prescription records, role-based portal access for doctors, pharmacies, and patients, end-to-end data encryption.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/genzipher1-0-codestormers/SplitRx

### 3. AgroSense
- **Problem & Solution**: Smallholder and commercial farmers often face severe financial losses due to unpredictable climate shifts and lack of transparent market intelligence. AgroSense integrates live weather satellite feeds with machine learning crop advisory models.
- **Tech Stack**: Spring Boot, React, JavaScript, MySQL, External Meteorological APIs
- **Key Capabilities**: Weather warning alerts, agricultural commodity pricing trend analytics, crop risk assessment recommendations.
- **Live Demo**: https://agrof-repo.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Fourth-X-Born/agro-sense-AI-backend

### 4. CashMaster 6688
- **Problem & Solution**: Manual currency counting and validation is time-consuming and error-prone. CashMaster 6688 is a custom-engineered IoT and embedded edge computer vision machine that visually identifies, validates, and physically sorts Sri Lankan bank notes.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, TensorFlow Lite, MobileNetV2 architecture, Raspberry Pi 4, Arduino, OpenCV
- **Key Capabilities**: On-device edge neural network inference, optical verification, servo-driven mechanical sorting mechanism.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DileepaPRA/Group_Project_CashMaster_6688

### 5. Chef Claude
- **Problem & Solution**: Helps reduce food waste by transforming whatever ingredients a user currently has in their kitchen into culinary recipes.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Google Gemini API, Express.js, Tailwind CSS
- **Key Capabilities**: Generative AI recipe prompt engineering, intelligent meal recommendations based on dietary restrictions.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DileepaPRA/Chef-Claude

### 6. ForeGoal — FIFA 2026 Prediction Engine
- **Problem & Solution**: Advanced predictive modeling for sports analytics analyzing historical international match statistics, team momentum, and tournament brackets for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Streamlit, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DileepaPRA/ForeGoal

### 7. Lyntra
- **Problem & Solution**: A collaborative knowledge repository platform designed to help developer communities and university students share architectural insights, technical articles, and code solutions.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DileepaPRA/lyntra-api

### 8. Cybernetic Personal Portfolio
- **Problem & Solution**: A state-of-the-art interactive portfolio exhibiting modern web engineering capabilities with circular reveal theme transitions, zero-CLS responsive performance, high semantic SEO structure, and native LLM indexing support.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion
- **Live URL**: https://dilee.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DileepaPRA/Portfolio
